name: relentless-data-skills
description: A collection of agent skills maintained by Relentless Data — each skill installs independently.

plugins.name: implement-issue
plugins.description: Implement a GitHub issue end-to-end: claim it, branch, code in small commits, run tests + a runtime smoke check, and open a draft PR — with explicit stop conditions instead of improvising.

plugins.name: prefect
plugins.description: Version-aware Prefect 3 guidance: a live docs-lookup protocol, CLI-first instance queries, and house standards. Prefect 2.x out of scope.

plugins.name: smart-git-commit
plugins.description: Groups changed files by affected area, creates one conventional commit per group, then pushes to remote — conventional commit format with lowercase type prefixes.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Take working-tree changes from branch to merged PR in one pass — branch off main, commit smart-git-commit style, open a PR, then squash-merge and delete the local and remote branch. Command-only: /ship asks before merging, /ship clean goes straight through. Detects unrelated changes and offers to split them into separate branches/PRs.

plugins.name: visual-report
plugins.description: Produce a single self-contained HTML visual report — an explainer, writeup, or diagram-heavy document built with Tailwind and Mermaid via CDN plus hand-crafted CSS/SVG. Use when the user wants a visual report, an explainer, a single-file HTML writeup of a system/process/findings, or asks to visualize or diagram something as a shareable document.

plugins.name: orchestrator-mode
plugins.description: Forces the main thread to act as an orchestrator and delegate ALL work to subagents instead of doing it itself — plan, dispatch, verify with a separate agent, synthesize. Agent-neutral across Claude Code, Cursor, and Cortex Code.

plugins.name: dbt-runner
plugins.description: Invocation discipline and failure triage for running dbt — a static preflight script kills environment failures before the first command, invocation rules prevent the self-inflicted ones (sandboxed shells, piped output, silent empty selections), and a signature-indexed catalogue maps error strings to ranked causes and fixes, including dbt-fusion quirks. Bootstraps a committed per-project context file.

plugins.name: dlt-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap a dlt ingestion project: install the dltHub AI Workbench project-scoped, then layer Relentless Data house conventions (Snowflake, Prefect, DuckDB dev loop) as a committed always-on rule.

plugins.name: snowman
plugins.description: Read-only Snowflake exploration via the snow CLI — schema discovery, profiling, hypothesis testing, and data-quality investigation. Bootstraps a committed per-project context; a guardrail wrapper hard-enforces read-only execution and stages user-requested DML/DDL as scripts for manual execution.
